messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER - High - Detected repeated region fallback loop between us-east <-> us-west <-> eu for routing policy 'smart-fallback-v2'. Escalation triggered. Ticket INC-4823.

maya: saw it at 10:12 UTC, spike in fallback counts and latency. dashboard shows cycles every ~30s.

lee: confirming. health checks toggling node health across regions, requests bouncing. 12% of global traffic impacted by increased retries and 5xxs.

jordan: can someone paste the fallback policy? suspect wrong variant mapping for eu region -> sending broken probe response.

ana: (typo) ana: i'm on it, grabbing routing config.

sam: quick customer note: support reported elevated 429s for a handful of enterprise keys in eu region. starting containment.

ana: (ana) config snippet: ```
fallbackPolicies:
  smart-fallback-v2:
    primary: region-preferred
    fallbacks:
      - us-west: weight 0.6
      - eu: weight 0.4
    health_probe: http://probe.local/health
    variant_map: { us-east: small-quant, us-west: small-quant, eu: medium-quant }
```

maya: that variant_map looks wrong — eu should be small-quant too. medium-quant forces longer startup and fails fast health checks on light nodes.

lee: agree. but the loop seems amplified by probe timings. us-east marks eu unhealthy -> route to us-west -> us-west sees degraded kv cache -> fails -> fallback to us-east. cycles.

incident-bot: added channel note: "Mitigation steps: (1) Pause auto-fallback for smart-fallback-v2; (2) Force pin eu variant to small-quant; (3) Increase probe cooldown to 45s".

jordan: propose immediate actions: 1) Pause fallback policy (set state=paused), 2) pin eu model variant to small-quant, 3) set probe suppression for 2min, 4) notify customers.

maya: executing step 1 now: `redwoodctl routing update smart-fallback-v2 --state paused`

maya: (output) "OK: policy smart-fallback-v2 state=paused"

sam: doing customer comms draft: "We're seeing transient routing fallbacks that may cause higher latency/errors for some requests. We've paused the fallback policy and expect stabilization within minutes. Will update." Want me to send?

ana: step 2: pin eu variant: `redwoodctl model pin --region eu --model small-quant --policy smart-fallback-v2`

ana: (output) "OK: eu pinned to small-quant for policy smart-fallback-v2"

lee: increasing probe cooldown: `redwoodctl probes update --policy smart-fallback-v2 --cooldown 45s`

lee: (output) "OK"

net-eng: network note: we also saw intermittent TCP resets from one eu colo; not primary cause but exacerbating. I'm running a quick traceroute and will open a carrier ticket if it persists.

incident-bot: automation check: fallback pause applied, variant pinned, probe cooldown updated. Telemetry shows fallback rate dropped 80% in 90s.

jordan: telemetry: latency p50 in eu down from +200ms to baseline within ~2m. 5xx rate trending down, retries down 70%.

maya: handing off to lee for postmortem and rollback plan. I'm going offline in 20m, leaving amber watch.

lee: taking OOO handoff. I'll keep monitoring for 1h. Next steps: revert probe cooldown to 15s after 30m stable, run canary re-introduction of smart-fallback-v2 with corrected variant_map, and schedule a config review with runtime/serving team.

sam: customer comms sent to affected enterprise keys. CS routed high-touch customers to SEA for follow-ups.

jordan: root-cause hypothesis: human typo in variant_map combined with aggressive probe cadence + a flaky eu colo network reset => oscillation. Action items: validate variant_map on deploy, add CI check for variant vs region SKU, add hysteresis to health probes.

net-eng: carrier flagged flaps in eu colo between 10:05-10:20 UTC. opened ticket CARR-8921.

ana: creating postmortem doc and including config diffs. will include timeline, mitigations, and customer impact numbers.

incident-bot: PAGER - incident auto-resolved check in 25m if metrics stay stable.

lee: notes for blameless postmortem: no policy name/title in controller UI, hard to spot variant mismatch. Recommend UI change + deploy-time validation.

maya: thanks everyone. summary for channel: paused fallback, pinned eu variant, increased probe cooldown, carriers engaged. No major data loss. Monitoring until 11:20 UTC.

sam: closing loop with support: CS will escalate if any remaining customer regressions; otherwise we'll mark incident resolved after postmortem.
